subjects.description: A straight path of pale grey stone pavers running away from the camera across a mown lawn, with a row of raised timber planting beds along its right side.
subjects.appearance_details: Grass grows in the paver joints. The beds hold dark soil and low seedlings.
subjects.orientation: Running straight away from the camera

background_setting: Behind the lawn, a long five-storey timber apartment terrace with planted balconies and trailing flowering vines. A line of small round-crowned trees stands in front of it, and the leafy crown of a nearer tree enters at the right edge. Blue sky, white cumulus.

lighting.conditions: Clear summer afternoon sun, near-white, not golden.
lighting.shadows: Short, crisp shadows on the grass.

aesthetics.color_scheme: Green lawn, honey timber, grey stone, blue sky.

context: A shared garden in a small green town.
